On Sat, 18 May 2019 at 14:39, Kai Lähteenmäki
<kai.j.la...@gmail.com> wrote:
>
> I'm searching for potential business cases for simmer here in Finland.
> I suppose complex, big data simulations would be good targets?
> Can you send me some code?

For sure, simmer allows you to simulate pretty complex scenarios (see
the vignettes [1], and especially the use cases in [2]). It's also
prepared for very big simulations: it's fast, and, although monitoring
is performed in memory by default, there's an interface to change
that. You can use, e.g., monitor_csv() to directly store the generated
data on disk; or monitor_dbi(), from the experimental package
simmer.mon [3], to store data on a database.

[1] https://r-simmer.org/articles/
[2] https://r-simmer.org/articles/simmer-aa-5g
[3] https://github.com/r-simmer/simmer.mon

Iñaki
